author: Not met my needs

title: Life changing!
body:
It’s been 4 days since I started using RoutineFlow and I love it!

I was recommended this app by my psychologist when discussing my ADHD symptoms. One of my main challenge was I was waking up late every day and rushing to the shower to get ready and enter my remote work meeting 5 minutes late. Every morning felt chaotic and repeating the same thing everyday was demoralising. 

Once I started RoutineFlow, I started waking up an hour early, finding time to have breakfast, shower peacefully and attend my work meeting on time. I’m also more organised now. For example, I now made a routine that I start at the end of my workday to tidy up my desk and pick out clothes for the next day. 

I think what really works for me in this app is the audio and visual reminders. Once I start a routine, I can see how much time has passed and how much time is left in the form of a large progress bar (this is useful because I can see the progress bar when without my glasses when taking a shower). The app also gives audio reminders when a step is halfway done and when there is 30 seconds remaining. 

My wish from the developer is to allow me to configure the audio reminder so that I can set it to a pre configured value, because I feel 30 seconds is too little time. The other thing is that the voice is the old robotic voice which sounds very unnatural. It would be really nice if it had a more realistic voice or even the voice from Siri. 

Finally, the daily streaks and insights view adds a level of gamification that really seems to help me. I’m obsessed with creating new routines and tracking them in the app!

title: Problem solved and an excellent app
body: I love this app and this morning found it was asking for payment again to allow me to continue - I’ve paid for lifetime membership so was very disappointed.  I contacted the designer who responded immediately and the problem is fixed (thank you Thomas!).  As a result I have deleted a previous ‘disappointed’ review and am now able to leave the review I wanted to leave,  which is that this is an excellent app that is completely changing the way I live my life for the better.  I had been feeling that life was getting away from me and that I was unable to structure and organise as well as I had done in the past.  This app, combined with James Clear’s Atomic Habits, has been revolutionary.  James’s book gives you the theory and Thomas gives you the tool to enact it.  Honestly don’t know what I’d do without it now.
